why: Analysis 1's hedgehog (expert selling plus the best-run store and distribution system, judged on profit per store with profit per region as the alternative, and a goal of beating Rival B) sits closer to the key's core-superstore flywheel, and it labels its derived figures and assumptions more carefully. Analysis 2 is sharper on the Stage 4 silver-bullet risks (mass cuts of experienced counselors, an outside savior, copying Rival B wholesale), but it narrows the core to a niche and uses profit per transaction, which moves away from the key.
